study type: Pre-/post-study design, pilot study with cross-sectional assessment of implementation outcomes.
exposure: e-Learning course targeting physical activity (PA) and sedentary behavior (SB)
outcome: e-Learning course implementation (fidelity, feasibility, acceptability, compatibility, effectiveness, appropriateness in complexity)
Early Childhood Educators' (ECEs) perspectives on the course
cohort: The participants were a sample of pre-service (post-secondary students) and in-service (practicing) Early Childhood Educators (ECEs) in Canada.
finding: The e-Learning course demonstrated moderate-to-high fidelity and was reported by participants as highly acceptable, compatible, effective, feasible, and appropriate in complexity for the professional development of Early Childhood Educators.
